translated_title: Public Insurer the Way to Meet CNTE Demands; 2007 ISSSTE Law Can't Disappear 'Overnight,' Batres Says
original_title: Aseguradora pública, vía para atender demandas de CNTE; Ley Issste 2007 no puede desaparecer "de un día a otro": Batres
author: Néstor Jiménez and Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: At Sheinbaum's mañanera, ISSSTE chief Martí Batres said strengthening Pensionissste and creating a public insurer is the viable way to address CNTE's pension demands.
